title: Trans-Zab Jewish Neo-Aramaic
description: Northeastern Neo-Aramaic dialect of Jews in Kurdistan
extract: Trans-Zab Jewish Neo-Aramaic, also known as Hulaulá, is a grouping of related dialects of Northeastern Neo-Aramaic originally spoken by Jews in Iranian Kurdistan and easternmost Iraqi Kurdistan. Most speakers now live in Israel.
